column3: Night train interior, he sits by the rain-streaked train window, his tired face half lit by passing orange city lights outside, his faint reflection overlapping the glass, looking out, wearing the same charcoal overcoat

Wide shot from behind: he walks alone carrying a worn brown leather suitcase down a rain-soaked narrow street of an old northern Chinese industrial town, 1970s brick apartment blocks, bare trees, one flickering street lamp, wet asphalt reflections, dusk blue hour, he is small in frame

Exterior of an abandoned 1960s Soviet-style Chinese cinema theater at night in the rain, faded red painted sign with large Chinese characters 红星剧院 with some characters missing, boarded windows, peeling posters, one weak sodium lamp, wide composition
Inside a dark abandoned theater lobby, seen from behind, he pushes open a heavy padded leather double door, a blade of pale light cuts through floating dust, his silhouette in the doorway

Very wide shot of a vast abandoned old theater auditorium, rows of faded red velvet seats covered in dust, shafts of grey light falling through holes in the roof, rainwater dripping onto the wooden stage, torn red curtain, empty, silent, symmetrical composition from the back of the hall
Close-up of his face in the dark auditorium, a thin shaft of light on his eyes, he has just heard something, eyes shifting toward the stage, unease and recognition

Close-up of an old 1990s silver portable cassette tape recorder sitting alone on the dusty wooden stage floor, its small red record light glowing, cassette reels visible through the window, puddle beside it, spotlight haze behind

1994, he stands on this same theater stage singing into a vintage microphone, playing a worn sunburst electric guitar, single hard white spotlight from above, cigarette smoke haze, sweat on his face, eyes closed, passionate

The same old theater auditorium in 1994, every seat filled with an audience seen from behind as dark silhouettes, hazy backlight from the stage, smoke, warm amber glow, dreamlike soft focus, no faces visible

In the empty dusty auditorium, in the very last row, one single figure sits alone wearing a pale beige trench coat, the face completely lost in deep shadow and unreadable, motionless, all other seats empty, dust floating in a light beam in the foreground, eerie stillness
Side tracking shot: he walks slowly down the side aisle of the abandoned auditorium, his hand trailing across the dusty tops of the seat backs, dust lifting, light shafts behind him
Extreme close-up of his hands strumming the strings of a worn electric guitar hard, motion, sweat, stage light flaring, black denim jacket sleeve, shallow depth of field, no face visible
Inside a cramped abandoned projection booth, an old 35mm film projector with its lamp flickering on by itself, the beam shooting through a small window into the dark hall, swirling dust in the beam
Extreme close-up of rainwater dripping from above onto old scratched wooden stage floorboards, a shallow puddle reflecting a single spotlight, ripples
A long dim theater backstage corridor with peeling green paint, a figure in a pale beige trench coat walks away from camera at the far end, out of focus, face never visible, one bare bulb swinging
1994, night, he runs hard down a rain-soaked street toward camera, black denim jacket soaked, hair wet, breathing hard, blurred red and green neon signs behind him, panic and exhilaration on his face

The empty abandoned theater stage, a single old follow-spotlight suddenly switches on by itself, a hard white circle of light on the empty dusty boards, the torn red curtain behind, darkness everywhere else
A dusty theater dressing room, a cracked mirror framed with old makeup bulbs, he stands facing the mirror, seen over his shoulder; dim, one bulb flickering

He sits alone in the middle of the empty dusty auditorium, facing the stage, medium shot from the front; directly behind him, one row back, a figure in a pale beige trench coat sits with the face lost in deep shadow, out of focus, he has not noticed

Close-up of a row of empty faded red theater folding seats in the abandoned auditorium, all seats folded up except one seat which is folded down, as if someone was just sitting there, dust in the air, cold light
Close-up, he whips his head around to look behind him over his shoulder in the dark auditorium, fear and longing in his eyes, shallow depth of field
1994, close-up of his face on stage in the spotlight after the song, sweat, looking out into the dark audience, a faint uncertain smile, as if seeing someone far away in the last row
